partner.line: Behold the rotting fruit of excommunication:

stanza: That at dawn, we ain't mazes

q.line: 'Cept a good long line of praises
stanza: Lord the wind can leave you shiverin'
As it waltzes o'er the leaves
It's been rushin' through my timber
'Til your love brought on the spring
Now the mountains all are blushin'
And they don't know what to say
'Cept a good long line of praises

partner.line: And they don't know what to say
